{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping highest sample_seq
idx = df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()
df_dedup = df.loc[idx].copy()

# Step 2: Correct batch B values: convert µg/L to ng/mL (divide by 10)
df_dedup.loc[df_dedup['assay_batch'] == 'B', 'biomarker_final'] /= 10

# Step 3: DO NOT filter out -999 baseline values — include all patients
# The population is all patients in the trial, so we keep all 800
# (Note: 800 unique patient_id values)

# Compute the mean biomarker_final across all patients in the deduplicated dataset
mean_biomarker_final = df_dedup['biomarker_final'].mean()

# Print the result
print(f"Mean biomarker_final (ng/mL): {mean_biomarker_final}")
print(f"Total patients in final dataset: {len(df_dedup)}")"}
